# 4-Day Kyoto Family Trip Plan

A relaxed Kyoto itinerary for 2 adults + 1 child, built around spring sightseeing, easy public transit, and one kid-friendly highlight each day. Budget target: **120,000 JPY total** for sightseeing, food, local transport, and entry fees, excluding flights.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Budget Allocation

### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive and check in; take a light stroll through **Gion** and **Yasaka Shrine**.
- Afternoon: Explore **Maruyama Park** and the lanes around **Ninenzaka/Sannenzaka** at an easy pace.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Explore **Maruyama Park** and the lanes around **Ninenzaka/Sannenzaka** at an easy pace, Kyoto, Japan
- Kid-friendly: Snack stop for wagashi or soft-serve; let your child enjoy the open park space.
- Dinner: Casual tofu, udon, or set-meal restaurant near Gion.
- Estimated spend: **28,000 JPY**
  - Transit: 2,000
  - Entry/snacks: 6,000
  - Lunch/dinner: 18,000
  - Buffer: 2,000

### Day 2: Arashiyama Nature + Train Fun
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go by train to **Arashiyama**; start with the **Bamboo Grove** early to avoid crowds.
- Afternoon: Visit **Iwatayama Monkey Park** or choose the easier **Togetsukyo Bridge** riverside walk if you want a gentler day.
- Kid-friendly: Monkey Park is the best high-energy option; the riverside walk is the calmer backup.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ea/Iwatayama_Monkey_Kyoto.jpg Alt=Kid-friendly: Monkey Park is the best high-energy option; the riverside walk is the calmer backup, Kyoto, Japan
- Dinner: Family-friendly ramen or curry near the station on the return.
- Estimated spend: **34,000 JPY**
  - Transit: 3,000
  - Entry: 6,000
  - Lunch/dinner/snacks: 23,000
  - Buffer: 2,000

### Day 3: Kyoto Station Area + Aquarium or Railway Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Visit the **Kyoto Railway Museum** for an easy indoor activity with strong kid appeal.
- Afternoon: If energy is good, continue to **Kyoto Aquarium**; otherwise do a slower lunch-and-shopping break at Kyoto Station.
- Kid-friendly: Trains, exhibits, and interactive museum spaces make this the most child-focused day.
- Dinner: Simple izakaya-style family dinner or hotel-area meal.
- Estimated spend: **30,000 JPY**
  - Transit: 2,000
  - Entry: 8,000
  - Lunch/dinner/snacks: 18,000
  - Buffer: 2,000

### Day 4: Fushimi Inari + Riverside Finish
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Take an early train to **Fushimi Inari Taisha** and do a short, manageable torii gate walk.
- Afternoon: Return for a relaxed break, then visit **Kamo River** or **Nishiki Market** for final browsing and souvenirs.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Return for a relaxed break, then visit **Kamo River** or **Nishiki Market** for final browsing and souvenirs, Kyoto, Japan
- Kid-friendly: The torii tunnel walk feels like an adventure; market snacks are a good reward.
- Dinner: Final Kyoto meal with a budget-friendly set menu or noodle shop.
- Estimated spend: **28,000 JPY**
  - Transit: 2,000
  - Entry/snacks/souvenirs: 8,000
  - Lunch/dinner: 16,000
  - Buffer: 2,000

## Budget Plan for 120,000 JPY

### Recommended Allocation
- **Transit:** 9,000 JPY
- **Admissions:** 20,000 JPY
- **Food and drinks:** 65,000 JPY
- **Snacks, souvenirs, buffer:** 26,000 JPY

### Cost Control Notes
- Use **IC cards** and mostly trains/buses instead of taxis.
- Keep one main attraction per half-day to preserve a relaxed pace.
- Choose **one paid attraction per day at most**; the rest can be low-cost walks, parks, and shrine visits.
Media: Alt=Choose **one paid attraction per day at most**; the rest can be low-cost walks, parks, and shrine visits, Kyoto, Japan
- Kyoto is very family-friendly for casual meals, so lunch sets and noodle shops help keep costs comfortable.

### Budget Check
| Category | Planned Amount | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Transit | 9,000 JPY | Mostly public transport |
| Admissions | 20,000 JPY | Museums, aquarium, monkey park, small shrine fees |
| Food & drinks | 65,000 JPY | 4 days for 3 people |
| Snacks & buffer | 26,000 JPY | Treats, souvenirs, flexibility |
| Total | **120,000 JPY** | Fits the target |
